meta.name: capacity-planner
meta.description: Use when an ops leader (Director of CX, Head of Support, VP Ops, Head of BizOps, Head of IT ops, Head of Finance ops) is sizing ops capacity, building a headcount plan, modeling utilization risk, planning Q3 capacity or annual support capacity, or designing CS coverage — and needs Erlang-C queueing math, P90 demand sizing, shrinkage-adjusted FTE, manager-trigger thresholds, and a quarterly hiring sequence with ramp + attrition. Apply when sustained team utilization is above 80% or when the team is growing >50% in 12 months. Run before committing the headcount budget. This is NOT engineering capacity (see vpe-advisor for DORA + cycle time) and NOT strategic 3-year workforce planning (see chro-advisor).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用排队论模型规划客服团队人力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是运营负责人，需要基于数据做客服团队扩编决策。
copy.tagline_en: Plan support team capacity with queueing theory models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an ops leader making data-driven support team expansion decisions.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你计算客服、IT 等运营团队需要多少人，评估当前利用率风险，并制定未来12个月的招聘计划，包括新员工上手时间和离职率的影响。
howto.when: 当运营负责人需要规划团队容量、制定招聘计划、或团队利用率持续超过80%时触发。也适用于年度容量规划或季度调整。

say.text: 我们客服团队当前利用率88%，帮我做容量评估。
say.note: Claude 会运行容量模型，给出建议人数和风险等级。

say.text: 明年团队要从15人扩到35人，帮我排一个四季度的招聘计划。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含入职曲线和离职率的招聘时间表。

howto.what_en: Claude helps size ops teams (support, CX, IT, finance) by calculating required headcount, assessing utilization risk, and generating a 12-month hiring plan with ramp and attrition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an ops leader plans capacity, builds headcount plan, or when sustained utilization exceeds 80%. Also for annual or quarterly capacity planning.

say_en.text: Our support team is at 88% utilization. Run a capacity assessment.
say_en.note: Claude will model capacity and output risk band.

say_en.text: We need to grow from 15 to 35 FTE next year. Generate a quarterly hiring plan.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a hiring sequence with ramp and attrition.
